Package com.galitianu.jev4j

Interface Question<A extends Answer>

Type Parameters:
A - the answer type produced by this question
All Known Implementing Classes:
Choice, Noul, Score
public sealed interface Question<A extends Answer> permits Noul, Choice<L>, Score
A typed question handle. Pass handles to TypeSafeClient.systemOne(Object, Question...) and read the matching answer back with SystemOneResponse.get(Question).

Handles are immutable. The wire key is either the explicit name() or a positional key assigned per request; the API does not use the key for inference.
